summary: Wired KR Musecat and JP otogesetchi rhythm scrapers with merge-friendly community rows (sid/source_url keyed, game_counts + count_evidence). Musecat: PocketBase list API + per-venue SSR flight parse for series/quantity; full KR crawl 308 open public venues (291 with mapped rhythm inventories). otogesetchi: atwiki area-page HTML tables for Tokyo metro (24 venues with cab lines; incomplete prefecture stub pages correctly yield 0). merge.py already listed both under OPTIONAL_COMMUNITY_SOURCES; added otogesetchi_tai evidence alias. run_all optional path: --only musecat / --only otogesetchi.
how_to_verify: python scrapers/run_all.py --skip-scrape  # merge loads data_raw/musecat.json + otogesetchi.json when present
Check data_raw/musecat.json: 308 KR rows, sid=musecat id, game_counts present
Check data_raw/otogesetchi.json: Tokyo venues, null lat/lng, game_counts from 台
risks: Musecat game inventory API is 403; depends on Next.js flight SSR shape (self.__next_f). Markup change breaks counts.
Full Musecat KR crawl is ~308 sequential polite fetches (~3+ min). Do not run on default weekly scrape without --only.
otogesetchi copyright forbids bulk republication; ingest for merge only. National coverage thin (Tokyo-strong stubs elsewhere).
otogesetchi has no coordinates; merge relies on name+address match to allnet/eagate/ziv JP rows.
EZ2AC/BeatOn/etc map to other (not in GAME_SLUGS). Classic maimai FiNALE folds into maimai_dx slug.
Bare counts without 台 (e.g. ポップン16) may undercount on some wiki lines.
merge priority for optionals is below ziv; official sources still win name/addr/coords.

smoke.otogesetchi: PASS 15 Tokyo core venues (13 with counts on retest)
